lines: Yukikaze held her hands up high with a huge smile on her face.
I also raised my hand and gave Yukikaze a high-five.
Ah, sorry. There was still some lightning left.
I told you I'm sorry. More importantly, we did well! Our coordination was perfect!
Your orders telling me "do this" or "do that" were annoying, but it was easy to fight. It was my first time feeling that.
Was it annoying or did it make fighting easy? Which one?
Both, I said! You've never given me orders before, but you knew exactly how I act. I'm impressed.
It seemed Yukikaze really was praising me.
The feeling of her making fun of me that I had had earlier was completely gone.
I've already seen you fight twice today, so I only had to give you orders accordingly. Thanks for following my instructions.
Yikes, so you were ogling me the whooole time. Fuma, that's kinda creepy.
Yeah, Fuma-chan does do stuff like that. Honestly, he is creepy, isn't he?
H-Hey. Don't tell me you look at me the same way, Fuma?!
Look at you like what? Anyway, I don't!
I-I see... that's good to hear.
(What the hell is wrong with them...)
(I gave them perfect orders, but I guess this the pain of being a captain... sheesh...)
